fitnessSpec.hiking: Very high - multi-day, largely off-trail approach via the Chilliwack River/Perry Creek or Redoubt Creek area to a high camp over rugged and likely bushwhacky terrain
fitnessSpec.packWeight: Heavy - multi-day camping gear plus a full alpine rock rack must be carried in and over the approach

partner_requirements.approachTime: Multi-day (2+ days) approach to a high camp before the climb itself
requiredSkills: Confident 5.6 trad/alpine leading on loose rock
Route-finding and navigation off-trail in remote, unmarked terrain
Multi-day backcountry travel and camp management
Rappelling and downclimbing for the 'complex descent'
Self-sufficiency/self-rescue judgment given the very remote, committing position
partner_requirements.experienceLevel: Advanced alpine climbers only - prior experience leading loose alpine rock and completing multi-day, off-trail North Cascades objectives is expected; not suitable for a first alpine leader

before.permit: Free self-issue Wild Sky Wilderness permit or trailhead registration; no quota or fee. Northwest Forest Pass at developed trailheads.
